data.long_meaning: The name नितीन is derived from the Sanskrit word 'नित्य' which means 'eternal, constant'. The suffix 'ीन' denotes one who possesses that quality. The name नितीन carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses.
